books.title: Clean Code: A Handbook of Agile Software Craftsmanship
books.author: Robert C. Martin (Uncle Bob)
books.description: A legendary handbook on writing maintainable, readable, and elegant code, focusing on principles, patterns, and refactoring techniques.

books.title: Introduction to Algorithms (4th Edition)
books.author: Thomas H. Cormen, Charles E. Leiserson, Ronald L. Rivest, Clifford Stein
books.description: The quintessential comprehensive algorithm textbook covering divide-and-conquer, dynamic programming, greedy algorithms, and graph topologies.

books.title: Design Patterns: Elements of Reusable Object-Oriented Software
books.author: Erich Gamma, Richard Helm, Ralph Johnson, John Vlissides (Gang of Four)
books.description: Foundational classic cataloging 23 classic design patterns spanning creational, structural, and behavioral software architectures.

books.title: JavaScript: The Definitive Guide (Master the World's Most-Used Language)
books.author: David Flanagan
books.description: Comprehensive guide for modern JavaScript (ES2020) including classes, modules, iterators, generators, Promises, async/await, and Web APIs.

books.title: The Pragmatic Programmer: Your Journey to Mastery
books.author: David Thomas, Andrew Hunt
books.description: Timeless practical insights into software craftsmanship, career philosophy, automated testing, decoupling, and code orthogonality.

books.title: Database System Concepts (7th Edition)
books.author: Abraham Silberschatz, Henry F. Korth, S. Sudarshan
books.description: Fundamental text presenting relational data models, SQL queries, indexing, B-Trees, transaction concurrency, recovery, and distributed databases.

books.title: Computer Networks (6th Edition)
books.author: Andrew S. Tanenbaum, David J. Wetherall, Nick Feamster
books.description: Authoritative guide to network protocols, TCP/IP stack layers, routing algorithms, socket programming, and modern 5G/Wi-Fi wireless systems.

books.title: Designing Data-Intensive Applications
books.author: Martin Kleppmann
books.description: The definitive resource exploring the architecture of distributed systems, replication, partitioning, stream processing, and consensus algorithms.
